title: Splice-Core: Low-Order-Bit-Splicing GEMM for Highly Energy-Efficient AI Inference Accelerators
abstract: arXiv:2611.25617v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Splice-Core is a temporal-unary/binary (tub) hybrid general matrix multiplication (GEMM) unit that minimizes low-order accumulation latency, while retaining value-dependent execution for high-order activation bits. We present two novel processing element (PE) variants: (i) Splice-BP utilizing bit planes, and (ii) Splice-LUT, which selects a shared weight multiple in a single cycle. Compared to a binary systolic array, Splice-BP/Splice-LUT achieve 77.4%/76.4% geometric-mean tile energy reductions, respectively, across 26 INT4 convolutional neural network (CNN) and large language model (LLM) workloads in 45nm. Splice-LUT further increases geometric-mean tile throughput by 44.4% and reduces geometric-mean energy-delay product (EDP) by 6.13x across the 26 configurations. Across the evaluated W8A8 convolution and expert-projection workloads, Splice-BP and Splice-LUT reduce tile energy by 77.3-88.1%. Post-place-and-route INT4 yields 14%/9% s

translated_title: Splice-Core：面向高能效AI推理加速器的低位比特拼接GEMM单元
translated_abstract: Splice-Core是一种时间一元/二进制混合通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）单元，它能够最小化低位累加延迟，同时对高位激活比特保留值依赖的执行方式。我们提出了两种新颖的处理单元（PE）变体：（i）利用位平面的Splice-BP，以及（ii）可在单个周期内选择共享权重倍数的Splice-LUT。与二进制脉动阵列相比，在45nm工艺下跨26个INT4卷积神经网络（CNN）和大语言模型（LLM）工作负载，Splice-BP/Splice-LUT分别实现了77.4%/76.4%的几何平均Tile能耗降低。Splice-LUT还进一步将几何平均Tile吞吐量提高44.4%，并在26种配置中将几何平均能量延迟积（EDP）降低6.13倍。在评估的W8A8卷积和专家投影工作负载中，Splice-BP和Splice-LUT将Tile能耗降低77.3%-88.1%。布局布线后的INT4（测试结果）实现了14%/9%的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: Splice-Core提出了一种时间一元/二进制混合GEMM加速单元，通过Splice-BP和Splice-LUT两种新型处理单元设计，在INT4 CNN与LLM工作负载上相比二进制脉动阵列实现约77%的能耗降低，并显著提升吞吐量、降低能量延迟积。
en_tdlr: Splice-Core introduces a temporal-unary/binary hybrid GEMM unit with two novel processing element designs (Splice-BP and Splice-LUT), achieving about 77% tile energy reduction versus binary systolic arrays on INT4 CNN and LLM workloads, along with significantly improved throughput and energy-delay product.
